title: BillingInvoiceGeneratedV2
description: An invoice was generated. Supersedes v1, which typed `amount` as a JSON number — a double, and therefore the one place the platform's own contract still asked a consumer to parse money into a float. v2 carries money the way every other money event does: an integer count of minor units in a string, with the currency's own exponent. v1 stays published until its producers have migrated; it is not edited in place, because editing a live contract breaks whoever is already reading it.

siteId.description: Which property billed it. Absent on v1, which is why invoices could not be attributed on the cross-estate panel.

totalGb.description: Usage, not money — a genuine measurement, so a number is correct here.

money.description: The invoice total. Matches Money.toJSON() from @baalvion/money.

amount.description: Integer count of minor units as a string — a string so a 64-bit value survives JSON.

exponent.description: Digits after the decimal point for this currency: 2 for INR, 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD.
